citation: 1901 S. Prairie Ave. [O. R. Keith / Norman B. Ream house, exterior from the south-west.] Unknown photographer, undated. Reproduced on chicagology.com, Prairie Avenue, 1901 S. Prairie.
author: unknown photographer

Prairie library image a19-cgy-1901-exterior, recorded there as 'link only'; the project's reference copy is the image store's (kevinrhaas/chicago-images, prairie-1904/files/a19-cgy-1901-exterior.jpg), committed since T-1903 at data/sources/assets/ream_1901_photos_t1903/ with its attribution.
locator: The street front from the porch to the canted south-west corner, and the south flank to and past its canted bay, from the south-west; 1827 Prairie's corner tower at the left edge; the fence and a gate post at the right.
rights_note: A secondary web reproduction whose original source and rights are not stated (the Prairie library's own ruling: 'unknown - link only'). Only forms, counts, places and proportions are read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset (no texture, no traced mesh), and the copy committed for the image gate (T-1903) is the store's, unaltered, with its attribution in the folder's README.
access_notes: Read 2026-10-27 (T-3185, piece 1 of T-1903) from the image store's reference copy, 1928 x 1176 px greyscale, sha256 f149c559704fa37545432dc354005d3d239d685dfc31089829769c9de3511db3.
note: The same house as the 1898 photograph, nearer and from further south: the canted south-west corner seen square-on, with one window column under a pedimented dormer; the south flank faced in the same ashlar, with two narrow window columns and a small light between the corner and its canted bay, a carved ornament on its wall, and the cornice and mansard carried round it; two tall stone stacks over the flank; the porch's paired Corinthian columns and responds and the stoop's curved cheeks; basement windows under the principal ones behind the fence.
what_it_supplies: the south flank: its facing, windows, stacks, cornice and mansard
the canted south-west corner's face and its window column
the porch's columns, capitals and the stoop's cheeks
what_it_does_not_supply: the north part of the front, the north flank and the rear
